name: ARMOR-SOLAR
role: Solar inverter and battery monitoring: protocol library and node design
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host
notes: Groundwork: the serial protocols of Voltronic / MPP Solar inverters and the console of Pylontech batteries decoded and tested on a computer, and the design of the gateway nodes and of the Studio menus. No firmware and no server or Studio integration yet; nothing has been connected to a real device.
